title: First Line in Swift
description: Completed your first coding exercise successfully.
criteria: Get at least 1 practice exercise right

title: Code Architect
description: Completed 10 or more coding challenges along the path.

title: Knowledge Seeker
description: Aced the quiz of at least one pillar.
criteria: Get 100% of the questions right in one pillar

title: Apple Scholar
description: Achieved a perfect score in 4 or more theory pillars.
criteria: Get 100% of the questions right in 4 pillars

title: Certificate in the Making
description: Passed an official mock exam with a score of ≥ 70%.

title: Mock Exam Master
description: Passed 2 or more certification mock exams.

title: Keeper of Terms
description: Saved 3 or more key terms in the glossary for review.

title: ARC Defender
description: Mastered the Memory Management pillar without creating retain cycles.

title: Cross-Platform Explorer
description: Studied ecosystems beyond the iPhone (watchOS, macOS or visionOS).
criteria: Take the watchOS, macOS or visionOS quizzes

title: 100 XP Club
description: Passed the 100-point mark accumulated on the platform.

title: Swift Academy Legend
description: Reached more than 350 points and leads the ecosystem.
